last.verdict: Record profit beat forecasts, but shares slipped after an already huge run.

reasons.label: Profit far above forecasts
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $23.90 beat the $20.30 estimate; refining margin hit $39.24 a barrel.

reasons.label: Peak-margin worries
reasons.text: Refining margins nearly tripled from $13.14; investors may doubt they can stay this high.

reasons.label: Lower volumes, Port Arthur costs
reasons.text: Throughput fell to 2.97M barrels a day from 3.09M; Port Arthur fire costs continue.

story: Profit has accelerated all year. Adjusted EPS rose from $4.22 in Q1 to $12.54 in Q2 and $23.90 in Q3, as refining margins climbed from $14.90 to $39.24 a barrel. Valero has now beaten EPS forecasts six quarters running.
